theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The Big Banks theme passes the absolute-trend gate, which historically reduced drawdowns on the TSX. With durability of 0.74 and full breadth, the trend-following discipline supports overweighting eligible themes to maintain participation while using the gate to exit if the trend breaks.
